items.text: Consumes #180's normalized usage record shape; no harness-specific logic here, that stays in #180 adapters.
One '🤖 Agent usage' comment, found only by <!-- BEGIN/END AGENT USAGE --> markers; never by position, --edit-last, or plan comment.
Never write usage into issue bodies, PR descriptions, or the plan comment.
One ledger record per (session_id, stage), refreshed in place; never delete others; order by stage, then timestamp.
Table columns: Stage, Session, Harness, Model, Input, Output, Cache Read, Cache Write, Total, Source.
items.exact: | Stage | Session | Harness | Model | Input | Output | Cache Read | Cache Write | Total | Source |

items.text: Multi-model sessions (from model_breakdowns) render one table row per model with that model's divided tokens.
Table shows rolled-up subagent tokens; JSON keeps a children array (session id, model, tokens).
Table plus totals row above a collapsed <details> holding ledger JSON in a ```json fence; table regenerated from JSON.
Rows with source 'unavailable' render em-dashes, not zeros, and are left out of totals.
Ledger JSON parses back out of the rendered body; missing or unparseable JSON gives an empty ledger, not an error.
Create or PATCH via gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}/comments for issue:N and pr:M; no local ledger state.
--dry-run mode prints the comment body without posting.
GitHub's 65,536-character comment limit is a reported hard error; never trim or summarize the ledger.
No price-list cost computation (pass through reported cost only); no aggregation dashboard.
Tests: ledger, table, round-trip, and stubbed gh on PATH (create, PATCH, skip plan comment, dry-run); run just test-unit and just test.
